title: 526. Repeated Substring Pattern

examples.explanation: The block "ab" appears twice in a row.
No block repeated whole times rebuilds the string.
The block "abc" appears four times in a row.

hints: A repeating block must have a length that divides the whole string length.
Try every divisor length of `n` up to `n / 2` and check whether copies of the prefix rebuild the string.
